description: This file is a PHP class defining a controller for managing comments in the admin panel of an OpenCart-based e-commerce system. It includes methods for listing, approving, marking as spam, deleting comments, and updating ratings, with references to models, views, and language files specific to comment management.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class for managing CMS comments in the admin interface, providing UI actions and batch processing capabilities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the comment management view, including breadcrumbs, header, footer, and main content.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of comments as a response, primarily calling getList().

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML for the list of comments, with filtering, pagination, and actions.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves selected comments, updating their status, and possibly associated customer comment flags.

methods.name: spam
methods.description: Marks selected comments as spam, disables them, and deletes their content if applicable.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected comments from the database.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Updates comment ratings (likes/dislikes) in batch by recalculating and storing the difference.
